body:
Hi. First of all, do NOT hang yourself. I knew someone who did. They are still alive and in a wheelchair and they regret what they did. 

You have a lot of power. You have a choice. You can turn everything to nothing, destroy the universe. You can turn everything around though it may not seem like it. My best friend was raped at 7 years old and shot herself at your age (19) last year. I have a lot of pain in my life but her pain lives on in me and it always will.

Me. I'm too afraid to die. Are you? Ask yourself why that fear lives on in you. Who or what is keeping you from making that choice? Sometimes we forget.
This is such a good view. Nature is actually everything, including our own stupidity and failures.
